Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
James Coupe wrote:
>
> In message <blUl7.3476$i_1.1...@news.infostrada.it>, Cartman
> <federi...@libero.it> writes
> >Vamp A bleeds, and vamp B blocks.
> >A plays sup Red Herring, untaps leaving B tapped: can B play Cat's Guidance
> >to untap?
>
> The block has succeeded, though the action is cancelled. So it seems
> legal.

Except that there's no longer any action to which to react. Reaction cards
can only be played during an action (being performed by another Methuselah's
minion). So once the action is canceled, no action modifiers or reaction
cards can be played.

--

Methuselah's
> minion). So once the action is canceled, no action modifiers or reaction

So when is the proper time to play Cats Guidance? If combat occurs, once
combat ends isn't the action completed, hence no place to play CG.

Confused.....

Matt

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


The action isn't over until all the effects are played (Fast Reaction,
Cats' Guidance, Hidden Lurker, Freak Drive, etc.), unless, of course,
one of the effects ends (cancels) the action.


